To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
1. We propose a new multi-layer deep learning framework named ONCF to model the pairwise correlations among the dimensions of embedding space via outer product.

(1) the proposed ONCF framework is effective for implicit feedback data, which can achieve better recommendation performance than existing neural collaborative filtering approaches; (2) the outer product operation is effective in modeling the pairwise correlations among embedding dimensions, which can improve the performance of the proposed ONCF model; and (3) the proposed ONCN model, which employs a convolutional neural net to learn the high-order correlations among the embedding dimensions, outperforms existing models.
1. A new multi-layer neural architecture, ONCF, is proposed for neural collaborative filtering, which explicitly models the pairwise correlations between embedding dimensions using the outer product.

using outer product to combine user embedding and product embedding is more expressive and effective than existing methods that use simple concatenation or dot product.
